'''Security''', also known as '''Alliance Security''',<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> was a branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence's]] [[Counter-Intelligence]] department. Security was tasked with recruiting agents and deploying them within other sections of the Alliance. The number of operatives and their assignments assigned to Security was a closely guarded secret, with even [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] unaware of their true strength. Two undercover Security operatives were assigned to Mon Mothma's staff disguised as aides. If a Security operative suspected an individual of being an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence agent]], Security would turn the case over to [[Retrieval]] for follow up and prosecution.<ref name="RASB" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was guarded by Alliance Security guards due to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horton Salm/Legends|Salm's]] suspicions of him being an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spy.<ref name="RS" /> Alliance Security assisted [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]] in freeing several known criminals from the prison world of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. They were then brought to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to distract [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] seized the [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
